freeze_rule: Semantic modeling begins only after this manifest is committed.

sources.observation: Profile describes Yukura as a student at KNCT and lists public achievements/experience including hackathons, Mitoh Junior, ICTSC and Kosen Robocon. The visible public repository surface is small.

Non-fork repository owned by Yukura-dev. Description says it makes an alarm sound when a Raspberry Pi Pico door is opened; primary language Python; project activity is concentrated around late Dec 2022 / Jan 2023.

README documents a personal build process: flowchart, Raspberry Pi experiment, Pico rewrite, hardware implementation, reed/tact switches, buzzer, MicroPython code, observed print-related behavior, LED-based debugging and an explicit compromise when Pico behavior differed.
Commit history shows iterative subject-side changes: initial flowchart and Raspberry Pi program, Pico addition, buzzer rewrite, experiment, loop removal, documentation expansion and README rename.
Non-fork repository owned by Yukura-dev, described only as a Robocon club manual. Metadata alone does not establish the subject's technical role, depth or authorship of specific manual content.
Repository is explicitly a fork of pandax381/microps, whose description is a small TCP/IP stack for learning. Fork existence alone is not evidence that Yukura implemented or mastered a TCP/IP stack.

scope_boundaries: Treat profile self-description and award lists as context unless project/action evidence independently supports a technical capability.
A fork is exposure/interest evidence at most unless subject-authored delta or other direct action evidence is frozen.
Do not infer TCP/IP implementation or C mastery from the microps fork.
Do not inflate one documented Raspberry Pi/Pico project into broad embedded-systems mastery.
Repository ownership plus subject-authored iterative history can support bounded implementation/troubleshooting claims for the door-alarm project.
A sparse public trace is allowed to produce a small constellation; do not manufacture extra Galaxies to fill the canvas.
